entries.finding: The performance gap between NetworkX and igraph is 6x-11x end to end — real, and an order of magnitude smaller than the 40x-250x figures that circulate for this category.

entries.title: Graph Analysis Libraries
entries.finding: NetworkX's PageRank is not pure Python — it hands off to SciPy sparse matrices — so the algorithm most often used to demonstrate NetworkX's slowness is the one where it comes closest to the compiled libraries.

entries.title: Procurement & Contracts
entries.finding: Open-source procurement tooling exists and is specific: OCDS Cardinal ships 11 named red flags cited to corruption-risk literature, FollowTheMoney models Contract, ContractAward and CallForTenders directly, and OCDS 1.1.5 is itself the cross-jurisdiction standard with 134 datasets

entries.title: Python Optimization Libraries
entries.finding: HiGHS is the default LP engine in both SciPy and MATLAB, and MATLAB has removed its own in-house MILP algorithm in favor of it. SciPy made HiGHS the linprog default in 1.9.0 (2022-07-29); 1.6.0 (2020-12-31) had only added it as an opt-in method. The same 1.9.0 release shipped scipy.optimize.milp, a wrapper around HiGHS, so SciPy's MILP support is HiGHS. MATLAB's linprog default is 'dual-simplex-highs' and 'highs' is the only algorithm intlinprog still has.

entries.title: Python Password Hashing Libraries
entries.finding: passlib has not shipped since 2020-10-08 — nearly six years — while downloads roughly DOUBLED to 41.3M/month

entries.title: Python Password Hashing Libraries
entries.finding: The OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet contradicts itself on bcrypt, and which sentence a reader lands on decides whether they migrate. Its bcrypt section is restrictive; its summary is not.

entries.title: Raster Geospatial Libraries
entries.finding: The official GDAL package on PyPI is still source-only: 3.13.3 (2026-08-18) ships a single sdist and no wheel, as every 3.x release has. What makes `pip install` work for most people is that rasterio's wheels vendor a whole GDAL — now 3.12.4.

entries.title: Raster Geospatial Libraries
entries.finding: earthpy's installable release is still 0.9.4 from October 2021 on both PyPI and conda-forge, while the repository has tagged three further releases that were never published — v0.10.0 (2025-05-19), v0.10.1 (2025-09-10) and v1.0.0 (2026-08-16).

entries.title: Monte Carlo Simulation Libraries
entries.finding: SciPy absorbed quasi-Monte Carlo, but that did not end the standalone design-of-experiments packages. sobol_seq is retired; pyDOE was revived under new maintainers and is now the more active of the two.

entries.title: Monte Carlo Simulation Libraries
entries.finding: PyMC is built for inference rather than forward simulation — its own README describes it as focused on MCMC and variational inference — but it does ship forward sampling in pymc.draw and pymc.sample_prior_predictive, so calling it unusable for forward Monte Carlo overstates the case.

entries.title: Monte Carlo Simulation Libraries
entries.finding: SALib has no NumFOCUS backing, despite being the default answer for sensitivity analysis in Python.

entries.title: Monte Carlo Simulation Libraries
entries.finding: OpenTURNS has the widest copula coverage in this set by a wide margin — more than twenty families — but it is not the only option: chaospy ships Clayton, Gumbel, Joe, Student and Nataf copulas. scipy.stats has none.

entries.title: Open Source CRM Platforms (Self-Hosted + Managed)
entries.finding: EspoCRM installs on ordinary PHP shared hosting — upload the archive, create a MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL database, run a browser wizard — while its own documentation still tells you to prefer a VPS or dedicated server in production.

entries.title: Open Source CRM Platforms (Self-Hosted + Managed)
entries.finding: Odoo.sh is not priced per user at all. It bills by worker, storage and staging environment, and its hosting price excludes the Odoo Enterprise license. The optionality sits in Odoo's Custom plan, whose single license covers Odoo Online, Odoo.sh and on-premise.

entries.title: Open Source CRM Platforms (Self-Hosted + Managed)
entries.finding: All four platforms sell managed hosting, so "self-hosted CRM" names a choice here rather than a requirement.

entries.title: Python Optimization Libraries
entries.finding: The Mittelmann benchmarks lost their commercial solvers in two waves, not one. CPLEX and XPRESS results were removed in 2018 after IBM and FICO demanded it; Gurobi withdrew in August 2024 and MindOpt followed on 2024-12-24. The benchmark suites themselves are still maintained and current, carrying 2026 run dates.

entries.title: Python Optimization Libraries
entries.finding: GEKKO solves locally by default now, and remote solve was never unique to it. Version 1.3.1 (2025-12-31) flipped GEKKO(remote=...) from True to False because public server load had outgrown the free service, and some solvers and solver options are reachable only with remote=True. Pyomo has long shipped a NEOS/Kestrel interface that submits models to remote servers.

entries.title: Python Optimization Libraries
entries.finding: CVXPY's DCP analysis checks whether an expression is written in a form whose convexity follows from a ruleset — it does not detect convexity. A convex problem can fail the check and be refused at solve time. CVXPY's own tutorial uses sqrt(1 + square(x)), which is convex, is rejected, and is accepted only when rewritten as norm(hstack(1, x), 2).

entries.title: Python Password Hashing Libraries
entries.finding: bcrypt is actively maintained and still ~3x argon2-cffi's downloads

entries.title: Raster Geospatial Libraries
entries.finding: xarray-spatial's revival held: 22 releases reached PyPI in 2026, through 0.10.17 (2026-07-17), with commits continuing to 2026-08-18. But 782 of the 800 commits it has taken since January are by one person, and 1.0.0 has still not shipped.

entries.title: Raster Geospatial Libraries
entries.finding: rasterio returns plain NumPy arrays and has never had native Dask support; its own concurrency documentation points readers to Dask as an outside tool for images that do not fit in memory.
